title: Progress-Aware Media Shelf
summary: A polished media shelf with featured content, resume progress, premium badges, and mixed editorial states.
description: A reusable SwiftUI media shelf inspired by streaming home feeds. It combines a cinematic featured card with compact continuation items, progress indicators, live and premium badges, and secondary actions so teams can present mixed catalog states in one polished module.
appStoreSearchHint: Netflix https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id363590051 | YouTube https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id544007664 | Apple Music https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1108187390
rationale: Streaming apps repeatedly rely on media shelves that balance featured storytelling with fast resume and premium discovery states, making this a strong reusable building block for iOS media products.
